# twingatetunnel_tcp (Ephemeral Resource)

Opens a local TCP listener whose connections are forwarded through Twingate to a private Resource. Use it for providers that speak raw TCP (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SSH, ...). The tunnel is opened in every phase that needs it (plan and apply), and is closed when Terraform no longer needs it or when the Terraform process exits.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `destination` (String) `host:port` of the Twingate Resource, e.g. `db.internal:5432`. The host is resolved by Twingate.

### Optional

- `local_host` (String) Local address to listen on. Defaults to `127.0.0.1`.
- `local_port` (Number) Local port to listen on. Defaults to a random free port.
- `ready_timeout` (String) How long to wait for the tunnel to work, as a Go duration. Defaults to `90s`. Ready means the client reports Online and a probe tunnel to `destination` stays open.

### Read-Only

- `proxy_url` (String) URL of the Twingate HTTP proxy backing this tunnel, e.g. `http://127.0.0.1:41234`.
